name: hermex-fixtures
description: Fixture manifest. Paired with pnpm-lock.yaml so the fixtures cover every package-inventory axis: declared+installed+used (@design-system/foundation, react), declared+installed but never imported (moment — the no-packages case from #75), declared but not installed (eslint — a manifest/lockfile mismatch, which no-packages flags but require-packages does not accept as satisfied), a root dependency the lockfile knows about but this manifest omits (react-dom), installed transitively only (js-tokens), and a pair imported as functions and never rendered (lodash, es-toolkit — the function-only versus group from #174, invisible to usageCount).
